name: Ashen Convenant
source:
A demon walks into the realm of death, carrying his lover's swords and a letter stained with her blood. She was hanged for mercy, he was born for war, and the world offered no apology. 

Now he stands before the god who made it possible... because grief left him nowhere else to go. 

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/ashen-convenant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个恶魔带着爱人的剑和一封沾满她鲜血的信走进了死亡的国度。她因怜悯而被绞死，他为战争而生，世界没有道歉。

现在他站在使这一切成为可能的神面前……因为悲伤让他无处可去。

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/ashen-convenant]itch.io[/url]]
